comment: Read from the maker's source and README at tag 2.1.0, which is the installed build; the only later commit on main is a build fix. The panel prints REC and PLAY above the same button, which is a state switch rather than two controls, and prints OFFSET above the second button. The two CV jacks are labelled only CV on the panel, beside STEP and LENGTH respectively. Skip mode reads STEP CV with getNormalVoltage(2.0), which is where the 20% default skip chance comes from. Menu item names were read from createSubmenuItem calls in ChordVault.cpp at the installed 2.1.0: two were wrong before this pass and are corrected here, 'Polyphony channels' (not 'Poly Channels') and 'Skip Partial Clock'. Two items had no line at all and now do: 'Play Mode' and 'Step Knob Offset Mode'.
